original.target_description: Study 2, main effect of camp size on benefit ratings in the 2 × 2 × 2 within-subjects ANOVA; article p.291 (source page 9), §2.2. Decision outcome is separately reported on source page 10 and is not selected.

n.sample_role: Participants contributing repeated benefit ratings; 162 is recruitment N only. Final analytic N not explicitly stated.
n.exclusions: Analyses omitted respondents (17%) believing more lives would be saved in the smaller camp; exact excluded count and final analytic count not printed in inspected section.

notes: Identity assessed from the supplied candidate: ResearchGate HTML parse reproducing the primary article, with matching title, four authors, Journal of Risk and Uncertainty 14:283–300 (1997), and DOI 10.1023/A:1007744326393 in its metadata. Primary article text begins at labelled L73; source includes duplicated excerpts and ends in a repeated excerpt at article p.295, so completeness of the entire work is not established. Relevant Study 1 and Study 2 methods/results are present. No PDF supplied; no layout rendering possible. Quotes retain canonical OCR, including 5 for equals and comma for less-than. Only original n and es are assigned; replication, p, and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. The p.9 locator identifies the benefit-rating camp-size main effect, F=160.5, with same-test printed p,.001 (p<.001). Requested d is not printed in the inspected results, so the printed F is retained without conversion. The p field is an unassigned placeholder; its same-test bound is preserved here and in the effect evidence. Recruitment n=162 and rounded exclusion percentage 17% do not establish the exact analytic N. No N inferred from df=132; no calculation from rounded percentages. There are no explicit mutually exclusive final-group counts to sum. The decision camp-size effect F(1,130)=105.4, p<.001 occurs on source page 10 and is a different outcome, not the p.9 benefit-rating target.
